claim: A dimension- and family-size-independent random-shift spectral partition gives a weighted one-pivot block-commuting approximation with squared error at most delta^2 + sqrt(q_A)/delta.
derived_application: Combined with INITIAL energy-to-commutator bound, the whole frame is approximated in one common noncommutative block algebra with error O((average Dirichlet energy)^(1/3)); this is not an EB/MASA conclusion.
primary_source_context: Bansil-Kachkovskiy, arXiv:2608.31000v1, Theorem 1.3 and Corollary 1.4; no theorem imported in the one-pivot proof.
attribution: Peer artifacts are enumerated and attributed in REVISION-01. Their agreement is not external verification.
next_gate: A dimension- and frame-size-uniform refinement of residual noncommutative blocks to one MASA or an independent actual-channel counterexample.
